mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals an aggressive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 205 indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 205.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 205 signals aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, creating negative equity return pressure over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 205.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1200), FEDFUNDS rises trigger equity discount rate increases, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1200 signals robust housing market demand, indicating strong consumer spending and economic growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 115 indicates strong industrial output, signaling manufacturing expansion and positive economic momentum that generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.0 indicates a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: High RSAFS (above 300000) reflects strong residential investment, signaling sustained consumer demand and economic growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 300000.
